Title: Osney Bridge towpath diversion Oxford
Description: Thames towpath access to Osney Bridge closed with diversion via alleyway to Abbey Road. Thames Water water main replacement works. Expected completion December 2026.

Title: Marsh Lock footbridge closure Henley
Description: Footbridge at Marsh Lock closed on safety grounds since May 2022. 2.7 mile diversion along A4155. Order until 31 Jan 2026 and may be extended.

Title: Sandford Footbridge closure
Description: Footbridge over tributary of Thames deemed unsafe and temporarily closed upstream of Sandford Lock. Diversion via NCN 5 cycle path alongside railway.

Title: Abingdon Weir walkway intermittent closure
Description: Weir walkway closed intermittently due to high river flows and fast currents causing safety risk. Walkway reopened 1 April 2026 after widening from 0.9m to 1.5m. Subject to closure during high flows.

Title: Temple Footbridge closure Hurley
Description: Pedestrian footbridge closed May 15 2023 due to safety concerns. Deck boards degraded beyond repair. Closure will remain indefinite pending replacement options assessment. Diversion via Marlow and Bisham.

Title: Bridge 142 closure Runnymede Egham
Description: Pedestrian footbridge closed February 2024 due to structural safety concerns from tree strike and cast iron cracks. Thames Path diverted away from riverbank.

Title: Bell Weir Lock diversion Runnymede
Description: Thames Path temporarily diverted at Runnymede Pleasure Ground due to extensive refurbishment of Bell Weir lock and weir complex. Diversion around construction compound. Work spring 2026 to autumn 2027.

Title: Streatley Goring towpath diversion
Description: Footpath Stre/24/1 closed to prevent public danger from eroding riverbank. Half mile diversion away from Thames via Manor Road. Repairs planned for summer subject to funding. Likely reopening late 2026 at earliest.

Title: Penton Hook Island closure
Description: Island closed to public since February 2025 due to diseased and dangerous trees, particularly ash dieback disease. Thames Path itself unaffected. Specialist contractor engaged to develop clearance project.

Title: Ten Foot Bridge closure Faringdon
Description: Pedestrian footbridge between Rushey and Shifford locks closed March 2024 due to numerous structural and safety concerns. Specialist survey completed. Thames Path does not cross bridge.

Title: Brentford Grand Union Canal disruption
Description: Path blocked on left bank of Grand Union Canal between bridge over River Brent and Brentford Marina due to development work. No official diversion. Recommend using Brentford High Street.
